actions.action: Hunt for caterpillars, slugs or snails at night with a flashlight for 5–7 nights, dropping any found into soapy water
Check hiding spots in daylight (under pots, drainage holes, spider plant leaf bases) and remove pests, looking for droppings
Check soil moisture 3 cm deep before each watering and water only if dry
